context.askBeforeReadingDescription: The Context tab asks before reading. Run never asks: its menu names the model.
context.briefDescription: What the chapter is about, which its translations read as background. Reading the chapter again keeps a summary you wrote.
context.chooseSeriesHint: Pick or create a series to keep the glossary across chapters.
context.cloudConfirm: {{model}} will read the whole chapter. This will use API credits. Are you sure?
context.deleteSeriesConfirm: Delete this series and its glossary? Its chapter projects will remain.
context.discussPrompt: Discuss text layer {{layer}}. Source: {{source}}. Translation: {{translation}}. Explanation: {{explanation}}. Use view_page for the page image.
context.editTermDescription: The term's source text, its translation, its kind and a note.

context.fixNoLines: No line in this project uses this term.
context.fixNothing: Nothing to re-translate: every line using this term was edited by hand or is locked.
context.glossaryDescription: A series' name, notes, characters and terms, which every translation of its chapters follows.
context.importExists: This series is already saved as “{{name}}”. Replace it, or keep both copies.
context.importLocked: Imported entries are locked. Existing terms are kept.
context.localConfirm: {{model}} will read the whole chapter on this computer. This can take a while. Are you sure?

context.readerDownload: Local models download automatically when reading starts if needed.
context.readingDescription: Reads every page of a chapter for its brief, the terms it suggests, and each line's lettering category and note, which its translation follows.

context.removeImportedLines: Remove these lines from the instructions

shapeNotes.none: Also used for text without a bubble.

ocrBox.description: A box drawn with the O tool becomes a text block. It's always read, and its action decides whether it's also translated and cleaned.
